notes: handover: workflow id 6ad1c66313ea2c28e645e538, saved version 1, not deployed (deployed copy is still the shell, definitionVersion 0). Input keys: poc_id (required), mode ('plan' or 'build'; blank means plan; case-insensitive), approved_prd_link (used only in mode build). Result keys: status (started | already_running | not_found | error), build_run_id (the Claude session URL; '' on error and not_found), message. A caller must read the deployed copy's answer, so deploy before the app or Approve gate depend on it. Callers should treat build_run_id as a URL string.
assumed: the '<phase>' in 'Build started · <phase>' is the mode itself, so the activity message reads 'Build started · plan' or 'Build started · build'.

assumed: the activity row's gate is none, actor_type system, actor_name 'POC Studio Live', posted_to is the row's slack_channel (name, no hash), activity_id is ACT-<epoch>-<run execution id> so two runs in one millisecond cannot collide.
assumed: the row's last_activity and last_activity_at are not touched, because the contract lists only build_run_id, stage and status. Say if the Home list needs them refreshed on Build.

assumed: a blank mode means plan; a mode other than plan or build, a blank poc_id, or a poc_id over 200 characters or holding a line break answers error without reading the row; a mode build call with a blank approved_prd_link is not refused, and sends an empty approved_prd_link line.

assumed: a Slack post that fails (blank channel, refused auth) does not turn a started build into an error: the post runs with onError CONTINUE and the answer is still started, with the message saying the Slack post did not go through.
Rule 6: client, use_case, slack_channel_id and approved_prd_link have line breaks and tabs turned into spaces in a Groovy step before they enter the key: value text, so a value cannot add a key line.
The trigger's setup and result schemas are unchanged from the shell (no enum or default added on mode); only the description was rewritten, since it said the body was not built yet.

The seeded row POC-northgate-onboarding-20261009 has build_run_id set, which made the already_running run possible with no write; the other 10 psl_poc rows had none, so a mode plan run on them would fire the routine.
